canonicalName: Undecidability of the word problem: logic and computability enter group theory

milestones.description: Shows the word problem for semigroups is recursively unsolvable.

milestones.work: P. S. Novikov, On the algorithmic unsolvability of the word problem in group theory, Trudy Mat. Inst. Steklov 44, 1955
milestones.description: First proof that some finitely presented group has undecidable word problem.

evidence.claim: Novikov 1955 showed undecidable finitely presented groups
